title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer — Kubernetes / Cloud-Native / Go (Contract)
description:
Job Description:

We're Thoras AI, an early-stage AI startup building the future of autonomous Kubernetes infrastructure management. We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer to jump in, move fast, and own real product — not just tickets.

What you'll do:

Design and build core product features end-to-end — from data models and APIs to production-facing surfaces customers depend on
Work across our Kubernetes/cloud-native stack (AWS EKS, VPC, IAM, ECS, containers)
Identify failure modes before they become incidents — you've seen what tutorials don't cover
Sit with customers, develop product judgment, and translate conversations into filed issues and shipped fixes
Own your work from design through production

What we're looking for:

Strong backend fundamentals — you're at home designing data models, building APIs, and living in a database
Hands-on experience shipping software that production environments depend on across Kubernetes, ECS, EKS, and the broader cloud-native stack
Proficiency in Go, modern frontend frameworks, AWS (EKS, VPC, IAM), and Linux as daily tools
Product judgment — you don't just build what you're told, you can decide what's worth building
You've seen real failure modes in production, not just in tutorials

Nice to have:

Experience at an early-stage startup
Familiarity with infrastructure observability tools (Prometheus, Datadog, Grafana)
Experience with ML or AI infrastructure workloads

Engagement details:

Type: Contract / Freelance
Rate: $50–$75/hour
Hours: Part-time or full-time depending on fit
Timeline: Immediate start preferred

About Thoras AI:
Thoras is an AI-powered Kubernetes optimization platform that predicts infrastructure demand before it happens — so engineering teams scale before the spike, not after. We're a lean, fast-moving team building something that matters. You'll work directly with our founders and have real ownership over what you ship.

🌐 thoras.ai

Upwork Job Category: Engineering & Architecture → Full Stack Development

Skills tags to add:
Go · Kubernetes · AWS · Docker · EKS · PostgreSQL · REST APIs · Cloud Infrastructure · React · Linux
